shots.purpose: Hook. Dusk, sitting on a garden wall; Danny's hand points and prods at his one-armed uncle across the road
Mick in profile, empty sleeve pinned; he turns and answers: 'A wolf took it. On this street.'
Back on the wall: Danny mocks with claw hands
Macro: a child's fingertip runs over silver nails in OUR windowsill (visual clue 1)
Tilt up our bedroom door to a bundle of wolfsbane
Full moon rising over the moor, gas lamp catches; Mick points the kids home; we hop off and turn
Child's window at night: Mick's torch sweeps the houses, then lands on OUR window (visual clue 2); hands recoil
Mick under the lamp, torch low: 'Wolfman Mick'
Dip: twenty years later. The order-of-service card in adult hands ('He kept watch.')
The old room: he touches the rusted nails; push in to the empty lamp at the end of the road (spoken clue)
After a black hold: eyelids open on the casement swinging, curtains billowing
Tilt down to the sill: a muddy clawed handprint pointing OUT
Phone at 03:07: Danny's three texts; 'you' in red; Danny still typing
Phone torch on his own hand: mud, then the nails lengthen, fur comes through; freeze and tremble
Proof: both wolf hands curl to claws; zoom jolt on 'out.'
Whip turn to the window: the lamp dies; a torch clicks on at the end of the road, aimed at us; push
Hard cut to black. Whisper 'Mick?' Title THE WATCH, PART I
